pageDescription: Auto-apply discounts on all store products when quantity conditions are met.
enablePromoDesc: When enabled, discounts apply automatically to all store products
disableOtherDiscountsDesc: When enabled, this promotion overrides all other discounts (quantity discounts, coupons)
promoDateDesc: Set the promotion duration (leave empty for permanent)
barSettingsDesc: Control the appearance and behavior of the bar above the store
showBarDesc: Display progress bar and notifications to customers
stickyBarDesc: Keep it fixed at the top of the page when scrolling
barPagesDesc: Which pages the bar appears on
discountTiersDesc: The more items in the cart, the bigger the discount.
howItWorksDesc: The discount is calculated based on the total items across the customer's cart, and applied to the cheapest item(s) in the cart to provide the best offer without hurting high-ticket margins.
disableOtherDiscountsAlert: Note: When enabled, products already on sale (compare price higher than current price) are excluded from this promotion, and any coupon codes are disabled for the order.
noTiers: No discount tiers yet. Add one or use "Ready Examples".
